description: This file contains classes and functions for integrating with GitHub, including parsing Python files to identify FastAPI endpoints and classes, managing GitHub repositories, and creating pull requests for code updates and tests.

classes.name: DefinitionVisitor
classes.description: AST NodeVisitor subclass to identify class, function, and FastAPI endpoint definitions within Python source files.

classes.name: RepoHelper
classes.description: Helper class to interact with GitHub repositories, parse Python files for definitions, and manage pull requests and code updates.

methods.name: visit_ClassDef
methods.description: Visits class definitions in AST and records them.

methods.name: visit_FunctionDef
methods.description: Visits function definitions in AST and processes them, checking for FastAPI decorators.

methods.name: visit_AsyncFunctionDef
methods.description: Visits asynchronous function definitions in AST and processes them.

methods.name: process_function
methods.description: Processes a function node, checking for FastAPI endpoint decorators.

methods.name: _get_integration
methods.description: Initializes GitHub integration using app ID and private key.

methods.name: _get_repo_by_url
methods.description: Retrieves the repository object from GitHub based on URL.

methods.name: get_installation_by_url
methods.description: Retrieves the installation object for a given repository URL.

methods.name: enrich_callgraph_with_github_context
methods.description: Enriches nodes in a call graph with GitHub data.

methods.name: _build_index
methods.description: Builds an index of classes, functions, FastAPI apps, and endpoints from repository files.

methods.name: _process_python_file
methods.description: Parses a Python file, extracts definitions, and updates the index.

methods.name: lookup_index
methods.description: Looks up definitions in the index by name and type.

methods.name: get_fastapi_app
methods.description: Returns FastAPI app definitions from the index.

methods.name: get_fastapi_endpoints
methods.description: Returns FastAPI endpoint definitions from the index.

methods.name: identify_app_for_endpoint
methods.description: Heuristically determines the likely FastAPI app for a given endpoint based on path similarity.

methods.name: enrich_node_with_github_data
methods.description: Adds GitHub file path, function implementation, and file content to a node.

methods.name: create_pull_request_with_new_function
methods.description: Creates a PR to update a function's implementation on GitHub.

methods.name: create_pull_request_with_test
methods.description: Creates a PR adding a new test file.

methods.name: create_pull_request_with_multiple_tests
methods.description: Creates a PR with multiple test files and coverage summary.
